GRAMMAR 2, PROGRESS TEST 1 - Units 1-2 (79-bet, PDF 77). Yuqorida to'q sariq sarlavha 'PROGRESS TEST 1 | Units 1-2'. Ramka: NAME / DATE / CLASS / MARK, '(Time: 20 minutes)'. Chap chetda qaychi belgisi (kesib olish uchun).

'Choose the correct item.'
1 The Smiths always ... their holidays at the seaside. A are spending B spends C spend. 2 She didn't ... to drive a car. A used B use C uses. 3 Jenny ... got three brothers and one sister. A has B have C haven't. 4 A: Did ... go to the park yesterday? B: Yes, I did. A we B you C she. 5 I ... at a sweet shop last summer. A worked B work C working. 6 A: Are they from Sweden? B: No, they ... . They're from Denmark. A aren't B isn't C are. 7 A: I never watch TV during the week. B: Oh really? I ... . A don't B does C do. 8 A: Is Pete ... the house this weekend? B: Yes, he is. A painting B paint C paints. 9 A: Do you walk to school? B: No, I ... walk to school. A always B never C not. 10 Mr Cook ... to own a farm. A use B uses C used.
11 Paula is sailing to Italy ... . A two days ago B next month C last week. 12 A: Did you play tennis this morning? B: No, I didn't. I ... swimming. A went B go C going. 13 Amy is ... a shower at the moment. A has B had C having. 14 A: ... that your bike? B: No, that's Jack's bike. A Is B Has C Does. 15 What is Harold ... these days? A do B does C doing. 16 A: Did you clean your room? B: Yes, I ... . A does B did C do. 17 A: Has John got a computer? B: No, he ... . A haven't B has C hasn't. 18 A: I love going to the cinema. B: So ... I. A do B did C does. 19 A: Did you invite Sally and Tom to the party? B: Of course I invited ... . A us B them C they. 20 ... I come with you to the cinema? A Do B Can C Can't.

exercises.explanationUz:
1-2-UNITLAR TESTI - 20 savol.

  PRESENT SIMPLE (odat): 1 always
    SPEND, 7 I DO, 9 I NEVER walk
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir): 8 Is
    Pete PAINTING, 13 is HAVING a
    shower, 15 is Harold DOING
  HAVE GOT: 3 Jenny HAS got, 17 he
    HASN'T
  TO BE: 6 they AREN'T, 14 IS that
    your bike?
  PAST SIMPLE: 4 Did YOU go? -
    Yes, I did; 5 I WORKED last
    summer; 12 I WENT swimming;
    16 Yes, I DID
  USED TO: 2 didn't USE to; 10 Mr
    Cook USED to
  KELAJAK (is sailing): 11 NEXT
    MONTH
  SO + yordamchi: 18 So DO I
  OLMOSh: 19 invited THEM
  CAN (ruxsat): 20 CAN I come?

  ⚠ 'didn't use to' - inkorda
  'use' (used ✗).

items.textEn: The Smiths always ___ their holidays at the seaside.
She didn't ___ to drive a car.
Jenny ___ got three brothers and one sister.
A: Did ___ go to the park yesterday? B: Yes, I did.
I ___ at a sweet shop last summer.
A: Are they from Sweden? B: No, they ___. They're from Denmark.
A: I never watch TV during the week. B: Oh really? I ___.
A: Is Pete ___ the house this weekend? B: Yes, he is.
A: Do you walk to school? B: No, I ___ walk to school.
Mr Cook ___ to own a farm.
Paula is sailing to Italy ___.
A: Did you play tennis this morning? B: No, I didn't. I ___ swimming.
Amy is ___ a shower at the moment.
A: ___ that your bike? B: No, that's Jack's bike.
What is Harold ___ these days?
A: Did you clean your room? B: Yes, I ___.
A: Has John got a computer? B: No, he ___.
A: I love going to the cinema. B: So ___ I.
A: Did you invite Sally and Tom to the party? B: Of course I invited ___.
___ I come with you to the cinema?

patterns.formula: EGA + didn't use to + FE'L / EGA + used to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: She didn't use to drive a car. Mr Cook used to own a farm.
patterns.exampleUz: U ilgari mashina haydamas edi. Mister Kuk ilgari fermaga ega edi.
